input.body:
label: bug
file: src/export/scheduler.ts

The issue described suggests that the first weekly export scheduled on the same day as its creation does not send until the next week. Reviewing the code in `src/export/scheduler.ts`, particularly the `nextRunAt` function, reveals that for weekly schedules, the next run date is always set to 7 days from the current date at the fixed hour 6:00 UTC. This means if a schedule is created later on the day it is supposed to run, it will not run until 7 days later, skipping the first intended occurrence.

The problem likely lies in the logic of `nextRunAt` for the weekly cadence, which does not consider if the scheduled time later that same day should be included. Adjusting this might require checking if the current time is before the set run hour on the creation day and allowing the export to run the same day if created beforehand.

This file (`src/export/scheduler.ts`) is the right place to investigate and adjust the calculation of the next run time for weekly schedules to fix the problem.

input.title: Triage of issue 4207: potential fix
input.body:
File: src/export/scheduler.ts

The issue describes a problem where a weekly scheduled export does not send the first week's export on the day the schedule is created early in the morning, but starts from the next week. Reviewing the code in src/export/scheduler.ts suggests that the calculation of the next run date for weekly schedules might be adding 7 days unconditionally from the creation time, rather than considering that the schedule could be set to run later on the same day.

A proposed change is to adjust the `nextRunAt` function to ensure it correctly calculates the next run time for weekly schedules, especially handling the scenario when a schedule is created before the configured run hour (RUN_HOUR_UTC). This would help avoid missing the initial scheduled export on the same day it is created if the creation time is earlier than the run hour.

This change targets the logic that controls when the next export should occur, aligning the first scheduled run correctly with the time the schedule is created.
